verdict.rationale: Terraform's core product is a CLI whose source is published on GitHub. It runs plan/apply on the user's own machine, keeps local state, and can store state in a remote backend the user chooses, so no vendor-hosted service is required (HCP Terraform is an optional add-on). The evidence implies self-hosting rather than documenting it explicitly, and community discussion of the BUSL license notes ambiguity around 'competitive offering' use. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation framing self-hosted/offline operation, documented self-hosted Terraform Enterprise deployment, clarity on BUSL licensing terms for self-hosters, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosting.
